findings: Keyboard focus lost on row open (non-blocking, confirmed): openPanel/closePanel rebuild #rows, so the focused row is destroyed and focus falls to <body>. Move focus into the panel on open and back to the row on close.

Mark all as read clobbers a pending Undo (non-blocking, confirmed): ibMarkAllRead() calls toast(), which replaces a visible '… submitted / Undo' toast, so the last action can no longer be undone. Skip the toast or keep Undo while prevState is live.
Incomplete tab semantics (non-blocking, confirmed): #ibTabAll/#ibTabUnread use role=tab without aria-controls, a tabpanel or arrow-key handling. Finish the pattern or use aria-pressed buttons.
